sn1.9:1.2: Standing to one side, a devatā addressed the Blessed One with a verse:
sn1.9:2.1:
“Here there’s no taming
for one fond of conceit,
sn1.9:2.3:
One dwelling alone in the wilderness
heedlessly
sn1.9:2.4:
won’t cross over beyond
Deaths’ realm.
sn1.9:3.2:
his mind well-concentrated,
well-aware, everywhere
released,
sn1.9:3.3:
one dwelling alone in the wilderness
heedfully:
sn1.9:3.4:
He will cross over beyond
Death’s realm.
